questions.q: What is the kinetic energy of a 2.0 kg ball moving at 3.0 m/s?
questions.why: Ek = ½mv² = ½ × 2.0 × 3.0² = 9.0 J (remember to square v).

questions.q: Which energy resource does NOT get its energy from radiation from the Sun?
questions.why: Geothermal (like nuclear and tidal) does not come from the Sun's radiation.
